name: Cloud of Needles, Greater
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level inquisitor 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, witch 5
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as cloud of needles except it deals 3 piercing damage per round and the damage is considered adamantine for DR purposes.
